connection.title: Connect to remote server
connection.description: Enter the server address and token to open its office.
connection.tokenHelp: Copy the token from the server’s serve-token file. After a successful connection, the address and token are saved on this PC and filled in next time.
connection.operationFailed: The operation failed. Check the connection or reload after a save conflict.
connection.savedLoadFailed: Could not load the saved connection. Enter the address and token manually.
connection.savedSaveFailed: Could not save the connection on this PC. Check write permissions and free space for the app data folder.
